nodes.name: 02.1 Encode PDF for OCR
nodes.notes: REUSED VERBATIM from examples/n8n/digitax_invoice_intake.json (same node id/parameters -- jsCode is unchanged, so it stays covered by test_ocr_nodes_reused_verbatim_from_intake_workflow). Do not modify the extraction logic here -- see the workflow-level note on why binaryPropertyName stays "data". Cloud lane only -- the local lane has its own identical copy, "02.1L Encode PDF for local OCR", so the two provider paths stay technically independent end to end. onError: "continueErrorOutput" added 2026-08-11 (same pattern as "02.5 Parse OCR/LLM output"): getBinaryDataBuffer can throw for reasons unrelated to the OCR service itself (e.g. a missing/corrupted binary attachment), and this must never crash the run unhandled -- it now routes to "02.4 Handle OCR service failure" instead.

nodes.name: 02.2 Build OCR/LLM request
nodes.notes: CORRECTED from digitax_invoice_intake.json (2026-08-10, final-demo-ui round): the original prompt hardcoded the expected buyer company, its approved addresses, and its VAT ID -- master data the OCR step must never see, since it would let the model return the "expected" answer instead of what the document actually says, silently defeating the downstream ORG-001 comparison. This node now extracts using only document-visible labels/layout; master data is used exclusively downstream, in the control logic, after extraction. digitax_invoice_intake.json itself is intentionally left with its original (uncorrected) prompt, since that file remains a historical, untouched reference. tests/test_n8n_flow1b_workflow.py has a dedicated test asserting no organization name/address/VAT-ID reference value ever appears in this prompt text again.

nodes.name: 02.3 Run OCR/LLM extraction (Gemini)
nodes.notes: REUSED VERBATIM from digitax_invoice_intake.json, including its existing retryOnFail/maxTries:5/onError:continueErrorOutput. Credential is the same REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CREDENTIAL_ID placeholder as the historical workflow -- select a real Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential in the n8n UI before activating; nothing is copied from any other n8n instance.

nodes.name: 02.4 Handle OCR service failure
nodes.notes: Shared failure handler for the whole cloud extraction step: reached from "02.1 Encode PDF for OCR"'s error output (added 2026-08-11) as well as "02.3 Run OCR/LLM extraction (Gemini)"'s error output (original). Both converge on the same nicht_pruefbar/technical_review/OCR_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE payload -- a missing/invalid Gemini credential, an unreachable Gemini service, and a getBinaryDataBuffer failure all fail the same safe way, never an unhandled crash / empty response.

nodes.name: 02.5 Parse OCR/LLM output
nodes.notes: jsCode extends the original digitax_invoice_intake.json parsing/normalization logic (same node id) with one addition (2026-08-11, dev-stack/AI-selection round): it now also emits `aiMeta` (provider/model/processingLocation/promptVersion/fallbackUsed) so this node's output converges on the exact same shape as the local lane's "02.5L Parse local OCR/LLM output" -- both feed the single shared "02.7 Normalize invoice (concept)" node. onError: "continueErrorOutput" was added in the final-demo-ui round so a malformed Gemini response routes to a proper nicht_pruefbar/technical_review payload instead of crashing the run.

nodes.name: 02.1L Encode PDF for local OCR
nodes.notes: Identical logic to "02.1 Encode PDF for OCR", kept as its own node so the local lane is a technically independent path from the cloud lane, per the AI-selection spec. onError: "continueErrorOutput" added 2026-08-11: getBinaryDataBuffer can throw for reasons unrelated to the local provider (e.g. a missing/corrupted binary attachment), and this must never crash the run unhandled -- it now routes to "02.4L Handle local OCR service failure" instead.

nodes.name: 02.3L Run OCR/LLM extraction (local)
nodes.notes: No credential/auth by default -- targets a developer-configured local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL), which is typically unauthenticated in dev. If your local endpoint needs an API key, add an Authorization header sourced from an environment expression here; never hardcode one. Bounded retry is shorter than the cloud lane's (3 tries vs 5) since a local dev endpoint should fail fast rather than mask a real unavailability -- see "01.9 Resolve AI execution profile" for the pre-flight configured-availability check that avoids even attempting this call when LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL is unset.

nodes.name: 02.4L Handle local OCR service failure
nodes.notes: Shared failure handler for the whole local extraction step: reached from "02.1L Encode PDF for local OCR"'s error output (added 2026-08-11) as well as "02.3L Run OCR/LLM extraction (local)"'s error output (original). Both converge on the same nicht_pruefbar/technical_review/LOCAL_LLM_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE payload, never an unhandled crash / empty response, and never a fallback to cloud.

nodes.name: 02.5L Parse local OCR/LLM output
nodes.notes: Same parsing strategy as "02.5 Parse OCR/LLM output" (strip markdown fences, parse JSON, default missing fields to "not found"), adapted to the OpenAI-compatible choices[0].message.content response shape instead of Gemini's candidates[...] shape. Output converges on the exact same {invoice_extracted, aiMeta} contract as the cloud lane so "02.7 Normalize invoice (concept)" can stay a single shared node.

nodes.name: 05.1 Human review - standard
nodes.notes: Phase 1b ends here: routed for standard-priority human review. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: 05.2 Human review - prioritized
nodes.notes: Phase 1b ends here: routed for prioritized human review (klaerung_erforderlich, or a nicht_pruefbar not_reliable-extraction outcome from ORG-001 itself). No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: 05.3 Human review - technical
nodes.notes: Explicit technical-failure route -- does not depend on the unknown-value fallback. Reached for missing upload, unknown organization profile, unresolved AI execution profile, local/cloud OCR service failure, or OCR output parse failure. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: 05.4 Human review - unknown
nodes.notes: Safety fallback for a routing value that matches none of the explicit routes above -- never silently ignored.

parameters.content:
## 01.6-01.11 Organization + AI-profile resolution
Organization master-data profile lookup (concept), then AI execution
profile resolution: the browser sends only a stable profile ID
(local-default / cloud-gemini). An unknown ID or an unconfigured local
provider fails safely to nicht_pruefbar/technical_review -- never a
silent default to cloud, never a silent local-to-cloud fallback.

## 02 Intake and normalization -- two technically separate lanes
CONCEPT/TEMPORARY: n8n-side OCR/LLM extraction, not yet processed by the
real API. Cloud lane (y=0): unchanged Gemini path. Local lane (y=460,
below): configurable local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, no model bundled
or auto-downloaded. Both lanes converge on 02.7 Normalize invoice
(concept) with an identical canonical invoice/fieldEvidence/aiMeta shape.

## 02L Local AI extraction (concept)
OpenAI-compatible endpoint via LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL/LOCAL_LLM_MODEL.
Unavailable/unconfigured -> nicht_pruefbar/technical_review, never a
silent fallback to cloud.

## 03 DigiTax controls
CONCEPT/TEMPORARY: n8n-side mirror of
evaluate_org_001() -- same field list,
threshold, and control ID as Flow 1a,
not yet processed by the real API.

## 04 Control report and routing
Adds AI-selection audit fields: processingPath, aiExecutionProfile,
aiProvider, modelId, modelVersion, processingLocation, promptVersion,
fallbackUsed. No secrets or internal URLs are ever included.

## VERSION INFO
Workflow: DigiTax | Invoice Phase 1 | Flow 1b | PDF OCR/LLM Concept | v0.2.0
Status: concept (inactive, credentials pending -- NOT part of the demo)
Boundary: plain PDF upload -> resolve AI execution profile -> local OR
cloud OCR/LLM extraction -> n8n-side ORG-001 mirror -> human review
(never approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication)
AI selection (new in v0.2.0): browser sends only a stable profile ID
(local-default / cloud-gemini); server/n8n resolves provider, model, and
endpoint. No silent local-to-cloud fallback; unknown profile or
unconfigured local provider fails safely to nicht_pruefbar/
technical_review. Both lanes converge on one canonical invoice contract.
Control contract MIRRORED, not executed by the real API: ORG-001 rule_version
1.0.0, threshold 0.70 -- see facturx/phase1/controls/catalog.py and
executor.py::evaluate_org_001. Real API convergence pending (see README).
